text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 6: Training gain describes splits; feature tests decide usefulness'
text.tspan: Figure 6: Training gain describes splits; feature tests decide

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Corrected wind and radiation inputs; squared-error models fitted separately for each meter using all 24 production features. Training periods: April 2024 to June 2025 and July 2025 to June 2026. Each meter's model is fitted three times for each training period, using different random seeds: six refits per meter. Blue dot: mean gain share. Blue line: minimum to maximum across the six refits. Each model's feature gains are scaled to sum to one; unused columns receive zero. Meters of one type have equal weight within each refit; the six refits have equal weight. Ranges describe variability across refits, not confidence intervals. Gain divides credit between correlated features and does not establish benefit. Horizontal axes are linear and start at zero; zero shares remain at zero.'
text.tspan: Corrected wind and radiation inputs; squared-error models fitted separately for each meter using all 24 production
Training periods: April 2024 to June 2025 and July 2025 to June 2026.
Each meter's model is fitted three times for each training period, using different random seeds: six refits per
Blue dot: mean gain share. Blue line: minimum to maximum across the six refits.
Each model's feature gains are scaled to sum to one; unused columns receive zero.
Meters of one type have equal weight within each refit; the six refits have equal weight.
Ranges describe variability across refits, not confidence intervals.
Gain divides credit between correlated features and does not establish benefit.
Horizontal axes are linear and start at zero; zero shares remain at zero.
